name: prose-drift-sweep
brief: Clear the 17 Prose drift items and the 2 Ungrouped documentation items in .sir/backlog.md. Each one corrects a comment, docblock, test title or Markdown line so that it matches the code at main d500429. Prose only: runtime behaviour, test assertions and CSS values stay exactly as they are. Every citation is re-measured against the current tree before it is edited, and an item whose claim no longer holds is closed as already resolved. Any figure that is restated, such as a contrast ratio, a margin or a count, is derived afresh and attributed to the command that produced it. The .dir-sdlc findings file gets a dated correction appended, and its original text is left untouched. Closed backlog lines are removed at Gate 3.
